$sources: BS 6399-2:1997 2.2.2.5 and Annex D (probability factor Sp)
source: BS 6399-2:1997: the standard design takes Sp = 1.0 (annual probability of exceedance 0.02) for every building; the categories I-IV are SAEngine's slots, all with wind importance 1.0 (Sp of another probability by Annex D: override wind.speedFactors.importance). Seismic importance 1.0: no earthquake loading (not covered).

I.description: Buildings of low risk (Sp = 1.0 in the standard method)

III.description: Buildings of high occupancy (Sp = 1.0; a lower probability by Annex D)

IV.description: Essential buildings (Sp = 1.0; a lower probability by Annex D)
